_comment: Baseline thresholds for the load-harness CI step (Phase 0.9). Phase 1.6 hooks scripts/loadtest_generator.py + scripts/dev/loadtest_probe.sh to emit numbers in this shape per run; PR job fails on >10% cold-path regression vs these baselines. Numbers seeded from pending-docs/performance_load_test_plan.md §0.2 success criteria; tighten as actuals come in.
notes: These thresholds are the v2.0 success-criteria targets, not Phase 0 actuals. Phase 0.3 runs scripts/baseline_metrics.sh which captures source-level metrics (LOC, file size, security comments); actual perf numbers from the load harness land in pending-docs/baseline/<ts>/perf.json once Phase 1.6 wires the emitter.
Phase 1.6 reads this file in scripts/perf_gate.sh and exits non-zero if any scenario's measured p-value is > baseline * (1 + regression_pct_threshold/100).
